text: OVERDOSAGE Manifestations of overdosage may include anginal pain, hypertension, hypokalemia, and exaggeration of the pharmacological effects listed in ADVERSE REACTIONS . The oral LD 50 in rats and mice was greater than 2,000 mg/kg. The inhalational LD 50 could not be determined. There is insufficient evidence to determine if dialysis is beneficial for overdosage of albuterol sulfate inhalation solution.
